Compresión y expansión de la intervención
relations.reading: The frontier cycle raises a governance question for compression and expansion: how can scaling retain the ability to explore without treating every expansion as extraction?

relations.title: Acoplamiento selectivo entre sistemas
relations.reading: A possible operational test is whether selective decoupling preserves room for exploration while reducing coordination that blocks action across the network.

relations.title: Compresión narrativa de capacidad
relations.reading: The invisible-talent model offers a useful counterpoint to symbolic celebration: capability remains alive through formation, operational missions and opportunities to exercise judgment.

relations.title: Contribución y reconocimiento
relations.reading: The attribution protocol could help distinguish symbolic prestige from the budget, ownership and decision rights needed to keep an exploratory capability operational.

relations.title: Transmisión de juicio tácito
relations.reading: The watchmaking case suggests a practical distinction between commemorating inherited know-how and keeping it usable within a federated operating architecture.
